arXiv:1409.8413.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$.

arXiv:0710.2918.abstract: We construct an explicit set of generators for the finite W-algebras associated to nilpotent matrices in the symplectic or orthogonal Lie algebras whose Jordan blocks are all of the same size. We use these generators to show that such finite W-algebras are quotients of twisted Yangians.
